Raptors get hammered 117-94 by the Wolves in Minnesota.

Shockingly poor Scottie night, scoreless (0-12) in 28 minutes. Jak had 0pts and 1reb in 19 mins. RJ was really good while it mattered, Ja'Kobe great in his first start of the szn. Nice mins for Graves later.
What an embarrassing effort by Scottie Barnes and the #Raptors.

Let’s go Minnesota Fans!

HOWL! WOLVES WIN! Defeat the Toronto Raptors 117-94 in their home opener to remain undefeated to start the season 3-0. Anthony Edwards led with 26 points. Toronto was aggressive defensively, but the Wolves matched their physicality. They shot 55.8% from the field, 48.3% from 3 point line.
#NBA 🏀🐺

record.text: Hopefully this is an early-season wakeup call for the Raptors. Minnesota is a really good team and they didn't have Kawhi, but they're gonna need to beat really good teams without Kawhi (or at least compete harder/better than that). Starts with Scottie and extends to the rest.
The Raptors seem to be taking a “confuse the enemy” approach to offense

This was a wake up game for the Raptors. The team is good but not quite elite yet. Would Kawhi have made a difference? We’ll never know. Would Scottie Barnes shoot this poorly I.e. 0-13? Perhaps not. Either way, Raptors aren’t there yet.

Raptors are giving up.

Time to get the backups in on both sides.
